services.name: Programs & Camps
services.desc: It's time for the annual Revelstoke banner painting program! You can join in by painting your banner at the Visual Arts Centre. This very popular league hosts games every Tuesday and Thursday, May through August, hosting up to 30 local teams, 14 teams per day with 1 bye, based on a "first come, first served" basis. This is a friendly, non-competitive league. Teams can keep score during matches, but the results won’t affect the league standings. Teams are encouraged to have fun, meet new people and enjoy the game! This is a licensed program designed to counteract the cycle of decline in mobility.
